Reactions in chats.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.2.0.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.1.x and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## New

- **React to a bot's message.** Hover a message, click the smiley, pick an emoji (👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 ✅ 👀 🙏 🔥 😮 😢). Same emoji again removes it; a different one replaces it. The bot gets a short note about it with your next message, so it isn't forced to reply.
- **Bots react too.** A new `react_to_message` app tool (`message_id`, `emoji`, `end_turn`) lets a bot react to your messages in its 1:1 chat and in its groups. A reaction can be its whole reply to a "thanks" or "ok", with no empty bubble.
- **Pills under the bubble**, one per emoji with a count; in groups, hover to see who reacted.
- **Saved with the chat.** Group reactions are kept and synced with the group's log; 1:1 reactions are kept on this device.

## Notes

- Bots pick up the new tool when Hermes reloads the app's tool list (a new chat session, or reconnecting the app). Messages sent before 1.2.0 have no id, so bots can't react to them.
